card.name: Embryo-fetal toxicity warning wording
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation inside embryo-fetal toxicity warnings: the colon after the heading, and words like "to", "a" or "have" in advice about contraception and pregnancy tests.

modes.label: Colon after heading
modes.description: The colon right after the heading Embryo-Fetal Toxicity.
modes.example: • Embryo-Fetal Toxicity<< :>> ETCAMAH can cause fetal harm

modes.label: Linking word in advice
modes.description: A small word inside the advice about fetal risk, contraception or pregnancy testing.
modes.example: Advise patients of the potential risk to a fetus and<< to>> use effective contraception. ( 5.

card.plain: It fires on the small connecting words in the standard pregnancy and fetal-harm warning text of drug labels.
